final: WITH large_tracks AS (SELECT t.TrackId, t.Bytes, t.Milliseconds, m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804), media_type_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM large_tracks GROUP BY MediaTypeId, MediaTypeName), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM media_type_averages) SELECT mta.MediaTypeName, mta.avg_bytes_per_ms, mta.avg_bytes_per_ms - oa.overall_avg AS difference_above_average FROM media_type_averages mta CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE mta.avg_bytes_per_ms > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY mta.MediaTypeName
